item.title: Cells move 42/43: lib moves into apps/lib behind shims
item.criterion: Cells move 42 of 43 (RFC 0006; plan entry 42 in bin/cells-plan.json): the path the entry lists for app lib move with git mv to their planned targets under apps/lib, and apps/lib/index.js is the front door, re-exporting the 0 modules other code imports. Each of those old paths keeps a re-export shim; nothing else outside the cell changes except path-map.json and the cell lint baseline. The cell lint counts change as the entry states (legacySource -1, shims 0, boundaries 0) and none rises; node bin/cells-plan.js --moved app:lib passes, and the full suite passes on Node 22.13 and 24.
